verses.text: Brothers and sisters, I could not speak to you as people who live by the Spirit. I had to speak to you as people who still follow their human nature, like babies in Christ.
I fed you with milk, not solid food, because you were not ready for it. And you are still not ready.
You still follow your human nature. There is jealousy and quarrelling among you. Does this not show that you are living like people of the world?
One of you says, "I follow Paul," and another says, "I follow Apollos." Are you not acting like people of the world?
Who is Apollos? And who is Paul? We are only servants who helped you to believe. Each of us did the work the Lord gave us.
I planted the seed, and Apollos watered it. But God made it grow.
So the one who plants is not important, and neither is the one who waters. Only God, who makes things grow, is important.
The one who plants and the one who waters have the same goal. Each will be rewarded for their own work.
We work together for God. You are God's field. You are God's building.
By the grace God gave me, I laid a foundation like a wise master builder. Now someone else is building on it. But each person must be careful how they build.
No one can lay any other foundation than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.
People may build on this foundation with gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay or straw.
But the quality of each person's work will be seen on the day of judgement. That day will come with fire, and the fire will test what kind of work each person has done.
If what someone has built lasts, they will receive a reward.
If it is burned up, they will lose their reward. But they themselves will be saved, like someone escaping through a fire.
Do you not know that you yourselves are God's temple, and that God's Spirit lives in you?
If anyone destroys God's temple, God will destroy that person. For God's temple is holy, and you are that temple.
Do not fool yourselves. If any of you think you are wise by the standards of this world, you should become foolish, so that you can become truly wise.
For the wisdom of this world is foolishness to God. The Scriptures say, "He catches the wise in their own clever tricks."
And again, "The Lord knows that the thoughts of the wise are worthless."
So do not boast about human leaders. Everything belongs to you.
Paul, Apollos, Cephas, the world, life, death, the present and the future, all of it belongs to you.
And you belong to Christ, and Christ belongs to God.
